# mahjong_graphic tile artwork

- Upstream repository: https://github.com/lietxia/mahjong_graphic
- Pinned commit: `3e275804ff58325306710bef3a7406860444bc6a`
- Upstream directory: `Vectors 矢量图/SVG`
- Selection: `1m`–`9m`, `1p`–`9p`, `1s`–`9s`, `1z`–`7z`, and native red fives `0m`, `0p`, `0s` (37 SVG files).
- `tiles/*.svg` and `LICENSE` are byte-for-byte copies from that commit. The SHA-256 and byte length of every selected source file, and the license SHA-256, are recorded in `manifest.json`.
- The accompanying `LICENSE` is the upstream license, reproduced verbatim. Its wording refers to fonts; it has not been replaced with an inferred SPDX license.
- The upstream README credits some designs (one through nine characters, the seven honors, and one variant each of one bamboo and one dot) to I.Mahjong: https://github.com/SyaoranHinata/I.Mahjong . It states that I.Mahjong was modified from GL-MahjongTile. This preserves the upstream's attribution chain; it does not infer any additional license or independently establish licensing for those earlier projects.
- The production atlas is generated by `scripts/build-upstream-tiles.mjs`. It only arranges the original 19 × 26 SVG tiles, prefixes each tile's CSS classes and IDs, and supplies cell viewports. Original path data, shape attributes, fill colors and aspect ratios are retained. There is no tracing, screenshot cropping, raster embedding, font loading or artwork redrawing.
- Upstream honor numbers are `1z` East, `2z` South, `3z` West, `4z` North, `5z` White, `6z` Green, `7z` Red. The application's separate game-value mapping must account for this order.
- `LICENSE`, this provenance note and the source manifest are distributed with the application under `/third-party/mahjong-graphic/`.

To verify the checked-in atlas without modifying files, run `node scripts/build-upstream-tiles.mjs --check` from the frontend directory. A regular invocation recreates the atlas and public attribution files from the pinned local source copies; it does not fetch any remote resource.
